title: FOOTBALL | Zakari Tillman Press Conference - 11/22/26
text: tell them start with >> Zakari, you're a Mississippi guy and uh so you kind of grew up in this rivalry, you know, what does this game mean to you and kind of what are some of your favorite Egg Bowl memories? >> Uh just being able to represent my state um playing for a lot of people back home, playing for myself, you know, again within side the state. Uh biggest rivalry of all time and you know, as I've been here for four years, I take it really serious. So, >> one of the things I remember too is um there was some people at your high school wanted you to go to Old Miss, but they ended up not offering you. I mean, so how do you feel about that aspect of it that Mississippi State recruited you and really they didn't? >> I take pride on it. You know, I use that as fuel, especially uh leading up to my preparation work this week. So, >> obviously at Champ, but as but the the less time he'll have to throw, the better. You guys had a pretty good performance in terms of getting to the quarterback and forcing tackles for loss on yesterday. What's it going to take to be able to build it off that well enough to be able to win on Friday? >> Uh just understanding our opponent and knowing that this quarterback is very talented. You know, he's a well-rounded quarterback and you know, being able to read um you know, just being able to have intentful practices knowing, you know, what we're going against. So, you know, that's just the way we have to you know, proceed this week. They like to run some tempo and obviously coach Leby's runs a lot of tempo. Do you think the fact that you see that in practice so much maybe helps you kind of prepare a little bit for this one? >> Oh yeah, absolutely. Gives us an advantage already knowing where we're going to get, knowing how we need to prepare for practice and you know our mindset. Talking about running tempo, u even though you don't go directly against him in practice now, what can you as a team leader, but also as a inside linebacker who knows what offenses do to help Billy get ready for games like this, especially at this point of his career? >> Just keeping his uh keeping his mind clear, you know, uh he's being thrown in that fire, the situation happened the way it did. And for me, just being able to encourage him and uplift him and know, you know, it's all going to be all right. and for him not to get discouraged in this process. I feel like, you know, that'll give him a little bit more of a clearer picture for this game. >> You guys have played a lot of mobile quarterbacks, but maybe not some one quite like Trinidad because he go 25 yards behind a scrimmage and then still make a play down the field. As a defense, how do you prepare for when he goes off schedule as coach Levy says? Uh just, you know, leaning back on our training, doing our job, staying in coverage uh in the scramble drill, being able to keep containing on him, you know, uh yeah, just doing our job. [snorts] Anything else? >> Appreciate T. Yeah. Have a good one.
